name: SyncRanker – AI SEO Writer, Content Generator, Stylized XML Sitemaps & On-Page SEO Suite
author: SyncRanker

sections.description:
SyncRanker Connector is a lightweight, all-in-one On-Page SEO Analyzer, Stylized XML Sitemap Generator, and AI Content Publishing Engine for WordPress.

Engineered to combine the speed of local metadata controls with the automation power of the cloud, SyncRanker gives you deep content analysis, real-time SERP previews, automated schema injection, and clean, high-performance XML sitemaps without database bloat.

Whether optimizing content manually or connecting to the SyncRanker SaaS Platform for scheduled batch publishing, SyncRanker keeps your site fast, fully structured, and search-engine ready.

🌟 Key Features

  • Real-Time On-Page SEO Analyzer (0-100 Score): Instant feedback covering focus keyphrases, semantic keyword density, subheadings (<h2>/<h3>), internal/external links, paragraph length constraints (<100 words), Table of Contents detection, and AI transitional footprint scrubbing.
  • Featured Image & In-Content ALT Tag Auditor: Automatically detects both post featured images and inline images to verify 100% alt-text accessibility.
  • Modern Stylized XML Sitemap Index (/sync-sitemap.xml): Beautifully styled XSLT sitemaps with dedicated, clickable sub-indexes for Posts, Pages, Products (WooCommerce), and Categories. Fully compliant with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
  • Dynamic Title Token Badges: Build modular SEO titles using clean tokens (%title%, %sep%, %sitename%).
  • Live Google SERP Preview: Real-time preview toggle for Desktop Snippets and Mobile Frames.
  • Automated JSON-LD Schema Generator: Direct injection for Article, WebPage, BlogPosting, and Product structured data.
  • Real-Time Topic & Keyphrase Uniqueness Engine: Verifies keyword collisions and queries semantically relevant internal links on-demand.
  • Interactive WordPress Dashboard Widget: Monitor site-wide SEO health and filter posts directly by score status.
  • Remote AI Publishing Bridge: Seamlessly receive long-form articles, featured images, and metadata directly from the SyncRanker AI Article Studio and Campaign Scheduler.

💡 How It Works

  1. Optimize On-Page SEO: Edit any Post or Page. Use the built-in SyncRanker Meta Box to optimize Title, Meta Description, Schema, and review the 12-point real-time checklist.
  2. Access Stylized Sitemaps: Navigate to /sync-sitemap.xml to view your Google-ready XML sitemap hierarchy.
  3. Connect to Cloud Automation (Optional): Go to SyncRanker -> Settings, link your SyncRanker API Key, and publish full long-form content pipelines directly from the cloud.

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to SyncRanker cloud services:
* SyncRanker Platform: (https://syncranker.com) Used for account authentication, remote article publishing, and accessing web SEO utilities.

Terms of Service: https://syncranker.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://syncranker.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for SyncRanker Connector or upload syncranker-connector.zip.
  3. Click Install Now and Activate.
  4. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes once to flush rewrite rules for /sync-sitemap.xml.
  5. (Optional) Go to SyncRanker in your sidebar to configure settings or connect your cloud workspace.
sections.faq:
Is the local SEO analyzer and sitemap generator free?

Yes. The 12-point On-Page SEO Analyzer, Stylized XML Sitemaps, SERP Snippet Previewer, Schema Generator, and Dashboard Widget are 100% free and unlimited.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. SyncRanker is built with strict WordPress coding standards, using lightweight native PHP and standard WP queries. It adds zero frontend bloat and maintains optimal performance.

How do I submit my sitemap to Google Search Console?

Simply submit https://yourdomain.com/sync-sitemap.xml directly in your Google Search Console Sitemaps tab.
sections.changelog:
3.3.2

  • Feature: Added highly-optimized, built-in Redirect Manager (301, 302, 410) with automatic slug-change tracking.
  • Feature: Added visual SEO Score color indicators (Red, Orange, Green, SyncRanker Blue) to Post list columns and Top Admin Bar.
  • Fix: Resolved minor frontend/backend context switching logic for the admin bar SEO score.
  • Tweak: Extensive WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) code sanitization and security hardening.

3.3.1

  • Enhancement: Implemented smart 3-tier “Waterfall” fallback algorithm in REST API for contextual internal link discovery.
  • Enhancement: Tier 1 matches semantic focus keywords/topics, Tier 2 fills gaps via shared category taxonomy, and Tier 3 utilizes fresh site-wide content.
  • Performance: Guaranteed strict post deduplication and current post ID exclusion across all internal linking queries.
  • Optimization: Added intelligent edge-case detection (isNewSite flag & post count threshold) to support clean AI content publishing on new WordPress sites.
  • Tested: Fully validated for WordPress REST API high-concurrency standards and SEO link architecture.

3.3.0

  • Major Release: Upgraded to 12-point real-time On-Page SEO scoring engine.
  • Added native Stylized XML Sitemap index engine (/sync-sitemap.xml) with XSL stylesheet support.
  • Added intelligent entity and morphological keyword matching in first 100 words.
  • Added Table of Contents detection and AI transitional filler scrubber.
  • Added featured image alt-text verification in SEO checklist.
  • Added on-demand REST endpoints for topic uniqueness and contextual internal link discovery.
  • 100% WordPress VIP and Plugin Check (PCP) security and performance compliance.

3.2.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
